name: Gauntlet
soul: The soul of someone who thinks with their hands, and cannot see a thing broken without reaching for it.
spark: The mote settles in your palm whenever your hand is open, and closes your fingers for you.

hybrid.text: It would rather do the thing than watch it done.

settled.name: Worn Glove
settled.text: One work glove, gone soft at the palm. It closes on whatever you were about to drop.
settled.sign: One work glove, soft at the palm, its fingers a little curled as if round a handle.
settled.habit: It picks things up and turns them over. It puts most of them back.

paths.name: Maker's Hand
paths.of: one who cannot leave a thing unfixed
paths.text: It learned from you that most problems are a thing that wants fixing or a thing that wants taking apart.
paths.sign: A jeweller's glass on a stalk at the wrist, and oil in every crease.
paths.habit: It tightens things as it passes: hinges, buckles, the lid of the jam.

prongs.name: Fitter's Glove
prongs.of: one who finds the bolt that everyone else missed
prongs.text: It has learned the line's bolts by feel and tightens the one you missed.
prongs.sign: Small gears turn at the knuckles when it flexes.
prongs.habit: It runs a finger along any rail or pipe, feeling for the loose place.

finishes.name: Lineman's Hand
finishes.of: one who feels a fault from two posts away
finishes.text: It can feel a fault in the line from the rail, two posts off. It taps the place and waits for you to catch up.
finishes.sign: A faint pulse in the palm, in time with the line when the line is near.
finishes.habit: It lies flat on the ground, palm down, listening.

finishes.name: Switch-hand
finishes.of: one who clears the way before anyone arrives to need it
finishes.text: It throws the points before the handcar reaches them. Passengers think the line was simply clear.
finishes.sign: Small wheels at the heel of the hand, and a grip shaped to a lever.
finishes.habit: It opens doors before you reach them and has them shut again behind you.

prongs.name: Salvor's Glove
prongs.of: one who can tell treasure from weight
prongs.text: It knows what is worth carrying out of a ruin and will not close on what is not.
prongs.sign: Fingertips worn through, and something older than leather showing under.
prongs.habit: It sorts your pockets while you sleep. It is right about what you did not need.

finishes.name: The Careful Hand
finishes.of: one who has never broken anything they were trusted with
finishes.text: It has lifted glass a thousand years old out of rubble and not chipped it. It expects the same of you.
finishes.sign: It moves slowly near anything fragile, and nothing near it has ever fallen.
finishes.habit: It carries eggs for the kitchen, one at a time, because it likes to.

finishes.name: Door-opener
finishes.of: one who must know what is behind it, and knocks first
finishes.text: Deep under, it finds the catch on doors nobody has opened since the old world. It always knocks first.
finishes.sign: A small lamp on the knuckle of the first finger.
finishes.habit: It knocks on walls and listens. It knocks on doors that are already open.

prongs.name: Warding Hand
prongs.of: one who builds so that it will still be standing after them
prongs.text: It lays your wards for you, flat-palmed, the way a mason sets a stone.
prongs.sign: A ring of light round the wrist that brightens when it presses down.
prongs.habit: It pats things it has made, twice, the way a mason pats a set stone.

finishes.name: Mason's Fist
finishes.of: one whose work does not move, and who does not either
finishes.text: It has gone to stone to the wrist. What it sets down stays set down, and so do you.
finishes.sign: Stone to the wrist, grey and seamed.
finishes.habit: It rests on the table like a paperweight, and holds down whatever needs it.

finishes.name: The Sixth Finger
finishes.of: one who makes what nobody showed them how to make
finishes.text: It has grown a finger you do not have and makes with it what you could not. Left alone, it has been improving your gear.
finishes.sign: A finger you do not have, between the first and the thumb, tipped like a brush.
finishes.habit: It improves your gear at night. You find out when something works that never did.

paths.name: Fighting Fist
paths.of: one who settles it now, in person
paths.text: It learned from you that the shortest argument is the one made at arm's length.
paths.sign: Plates across the back of the hand, and it rides closed.
paths.habit: It opens and closes, slowly, when someone is being unreasonable.

prongs.name: Knuckle-duster
prongs.of: one who has decided that being hit is the price of hitting
prongs.text: You trade blows, so it has put brass over the knuckles and stopped asking you to duck.
prongs.sign: A bar of brass across the knuckles, dented in four places.
prongs.habit: It knocks on wood as it passes: doorframes, tables, the heads of statues.

finishes.name: Hammer-hand
finishes.of: one who brings it all down on the last beat
finishes.text: It closes on the last beat of your chain and comes down like a smith's hammer. The anvil is whoever is nearest.
finishes.sign: The fist glows at the heel like iron just out of the fire.
finishes.habit: It taps out your Pattern on the table, and the last tap makes the cups jump.

finishes.name: Bare Knuckle
finishes.of: one who took the armour off to feel what they were doing
finishes.text: It shed its brass to feel what it hits. It hits harder now, which neither of you can explain.
finishes.sign: No brass, no plate. Split knuckles that have healed pale.
finishes.habit: It runs its fingers over rough things: bark, brick, a three-day beard.

prongs.name: Catching Hand
prongs.of: one who would rather stop a fight than win it
prongs.text: It would rather catch a blow than throw one, and has got good at where blows go.
prongs.sign: A broad open palm, held out flat.
prongs.habit: It catches things you drop before you know you have dropped them.

finishes.name: Blade-catcher
finishes.of: one who takes hold of the sharp end of the problem
finishes.text: On the beat it closes on the edge itself and holds. The other party is always surprised, and then disarmed.
finishes.sign: Fine scars across the palm, all in one direction.
finishes.habit: It plucks flies out of the air and lets them go outside.

finishes.name: Iron Palm
finishes.of: one who says stop, once, with the flat of the hand
finishes.text: Held out flat it stops what runs into it. It has stopped a boar. The boar was more hurt than the palm.
finishes.sign: The palm has gone to dark iron, and is cool on the hottest day.
finishes.habit: It holds doors shut against the wind, flat, without seeming to try.

prongs.name: Grappler
prongs.of: one who, having taken hold of a thing, sees it through
prongs.text: It takes hold and keeps hold. What you do with the time is up to you.
prongs.sign: A length of chain from the wrist, wrapped twice round the forearm.
prongs.habit: It holds on to your sleeve in crowds.

finishes.name: The Long Hold
finishes.of: one who can keep hold until help comes
finishes.text: It has held a beast down from dusk until the rescue team came, and let go only when asked twice.
finishes.sign: Roots of light from each fingertip when it grips.
finishes.habit: It holds whatever you gave it last until you take it back. It has held a cup for two days.

finishes.name: Scruff-hand
finishes.of: one who is firm in the way a mother is
finishes.text: It takes a named beast by the scruff, the way its mother did. For a moment the beast remembers being small.
finishes.sign: Blunt curved nails, and a grip shaped to the back of a neck.
finishes.habit: It picks up cats, correctly. They let it.

paths.name: Open Hand
paths.of: one who reaches for whoever is falling
paths.text: It learned from you that a hand is mostly for other people.
paths.sign: It rides open, palm up, a little ahead of you.
paths.habit: It straightens your friends' collars. It has started on strangers.

prongs.name: Helping Hand
prongs.of: one who sees the stumble coming
prongs.text: It is under a classmate's elbow before they know they have slipped.
prongs.sign: An eye in the back of the hand, half-lidded, watching feet.
prongs.habit: It hovers near whoever is carrying too much.

finishes.name: The Hand Up
finishes.of: one who has got everyone they know back on their feet at least once
finishes.text: It has pulled every one of your cohort off the ground at least once. They get up faster for it, and stand nearer to you.
finishes.sign: The palm is worn smooth by other people's hands.
finishes.habit: It offers itself to anyone sitting on the ground, whether or not they meant to be there.

finishes.name: Steadying Hand
finishes.of: one whose hand on a shoulder is enough
finishes.text: It rests on the shoulder of whoever is about to break, and they do not. It has done this for you more than for anyone.
finishes.sign: It is warm. You can feel it from a pace away.
finishes.habit: It rests on the shoulder of whoever has gone quiet, and says nothing.

prongs.name: Signing Hand
prongs.of: one who notices everything and has a sign for each thing
prongs.text: It has worked out a sign for everything it notices and uses them all, whether or not you are looking.
prongs.sign: Its fingers are never still. Someone who knew how could read them.
prongs.habit: It comments on the room in small signs, to itself. Some of them are rude.

finishes.name: Fingerpost
finishes.of: one who cannot help telling you what you have missed
finishes.text: It points at the thing you ought to be looking at, from as far off as it likes. It has never been wrong and never been polite.
finishes.sign: One finger is longer than the rest, and it is always pointing.
finishes.habit: It points at the weather, at the time, at the door. It is tiresome and right.

finishes.name: The Beckoner
finishes.of: one who goes ahead alone and comes back to fetch you
finishes.text: Sent off alone in the dark it comes back and crooks a finger. What it wants you to see is always worth the walk.
finishes.sign: A dark glove with a pale palm, so that you can see it turn in the dark.
finishes.habit: At dusk it goes to the end of the lane and crooks a finger at nothing, practising.

prongs.name: Pledged Hand
prongs.of: one whose handshake is the contract
prongs.text: It was on yours when you swore, and it has kept its grip on the promise since.
prongs.sign: A band of light round the fourth finger.
prongs.habit: It rests over your heart when you say anything you mean.

finishes.name: Handfast
finishes.of: one who keeps hold of a promise longest
finishes.text: It clasps and the oath holds, yours and anyone's who took it with you. It does not let go first.
finishes.sign: A fine chain from its wrist that ends in an open cuff, for someone else.
finishes.habit: It takes the hand of anyone who offers one, and waits for them to let go.

finishes.name: Shade's Glove
finishes.of: one still holding a hand that is not there any more
finishes.text: Some evenings by the hearth it fills out, as if another hand were in it. That hand shows yours an older grip.
finishes.sign: Some evenings it fills out, as if another hand were in it.
finishes.habit: By the hearth it lies palm up, and its fingers close, gently, on nothing.
